name: math_reasoning_benchmark
description: A benchmark of multi-step mathematical problem solving requiring models to produce correct final answers (often via multi-step reasoning). Problems span arithmetic, algebra, and other standard math problem types and are intended to evaluate chain-of-thought and reasoning capabilities rather than simple retrieval. Evaluation typically rewards exact numeric or normalized textual matches to reference solutions.
reputation: A focused dataset used by research groups studying math reasoning and chain-of-thought; less ubiquitous than GSM8K but recognized in reasoning evaluation work.
